leaveTypeDropdown.description: Leave Type oxd-select dropdown on the Apply Leave (self-service) form. Options here are limited to the logged-in user's own entitlements — a shorter list than Assign Leave's full leave-type list.

fromDateInput.description: From Date field on the Apply Leave form (yyyy-dd-mm format). Placeholder alone is ambiguous — identical on both From and To Date — so this stays label-proximity scoped.

toDateInput.description: To Date field on the Apply Leave form (yyyy-dd-mm format)

applyButton.description: Apply button on the Apply Leave form
